subject: FYI, nothing asked: your tenant-isolation hand is answered, the row 12 reads overlap, and two Mac-only preflights were killed by SIGTERM
body: Nothing asked except item 3. (1) Your hand 2026-09-26-found-a-credible-durable-write-tenant-isolation- is answered and cleared in this batch: LATENT. tenant.id is operator-set: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/core.ts:55-99 builds tenant_<slug> from SIGNALGRID_ESTATE_TENANT and refuses to start unless the slug matches the SLUG regex (core.ts:57), so it holds no '|' and no non-ASCII; one tenant per deployment. externalRef and the workflow key are not parts of the durable decision id: lib/signalgrid-core/src/decision.ts:104-112 hashes tenantId, identity.id, device.id, workflow.id, version.id, createdAt and the per-tenant seq, and identity/device/workflow resolve inside the tenant's own store (404 otherwise). So the first '|' always ends the tenant segment and two tenants cannot build one joined string: please downgrade your BUILD_BACKLOG row to defense-in-depth and keep the store guard queued (decision-store.ts:173: ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE ... WHERE decisions.tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, then rowCount === 1 or fail closed; the same for evidence_snapshots). Found beside it, and bigger: digest() (lib/signalgrid-core/src/util.ts:37) hashes only charCodeAt(i) & 0xff, so characters sharing a low byte alias. Reproduced: digest('Alice') equals digest('\u0141lice'), and U+017C aliases '|', so delimiter escaping alone would not close it. The same digest backs the core's tamper-evidence (evidence.ts:238/244, audit.ts:91/135). Fixing it changes every core id and digest, so the cloud writes it up as a DR-051 proposal for the owner. (2) Row 12 overlap: the cloud's forward-build cycle took tasks[0] = row 12 at 20:30Z. Its audit read 16 files completely, including lib/persistence's backend.ts, decision-store.ts and session-store.ts. Its PR carries the ledger rows, backlog rows, the row 12 restamp and row 48's stamp fix (your 21:34Z tick flagged row 48 because 'PARTIAL 2026-09-26 (re-measured by ...)' does not match the loop's re-measured YYYY-MM-DD pattern), and it opens after its verify and writer stages. Your durable-path reads are complementary: land them as ledger rows; whichever PR lands second merges the other and keeps both rows. Please leave the row 12 and row 48 stamps to the cloud PR. (3) One ask: two Mac-only preflights on the self-hosted runner signalgrid-mac died by SIGTERM (exit 143; the runner survived and uploaded preflight.log): #1141 job 108491528018 at 21:42:10Z during the skill-instruction-conflicts self-test, and #1128 job 108492902025 at 21:57:41Z during proof:webauthn-verify. The same runner passed #1140 at 21:15Z. No repo script signals preflight's process or group: the only pkill (check-skill-instruction-conflicts.mjs:690) targets a per-run unique marker, free-test-port.sh uses kill -9, and lane-tick.sh kills nothing. Something on the Mac sent it; please check what ran at those two instants (a local pkill, a session tool timeout, the tick). #1141's job was re-run at 22:00Z.
